game.name: Supreme Commander (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: Supreme Commander is a strategy game for Xbox 360 in which you take the lead of one of the three available factions, the United Terran Federation, the Aeons or the Cybrans. You have to use your ingenuity to make the best use of the hundreds of units available and to take control of the huge battlefields. A multiplayer mode allows you to extend the adventure and compete with other strategists on the Internet.
